title: Producer/ledger plumbing: node execution rows carry parent_run_id + receipt_sha256; manifest names launch_run_id; C-009 ledger and caps
objective: Make every produced bundle carry the BX1/BX2 binding: RECEIPT ledger rows record parent_run_id (the TOP_LEVEL build row) and receipt_sha256 (rso.binding.binding.receipt_sha256 of the receipt canonical bytes) at finish; the bundle MANIFEST.json records launch_run_id; inventory() exposes both fields; s2_run produce can charge rso/binding/LEDGER.jsonl under rso/binding/contract.json caps.
problem: Settled design (CONTRACT.md s2 BX1-BX3, contract.json row_fields): field names parent_run_id, receipt_sha256 on node execution rows; launch_run_id in the manifest. Order: the receipt is built before its row finishes, so the row digest is computed from the final receipt bytes (no circularity: the receipt carries run_id, never the digest). s2_run produce: add a --contract option (default the slice contract) so a C-009 produce charges rso/binding/LEDGER.jsonl against rso/binding/contract.json. Keep existing row fields; old ledgers still parse (rows without the new fields are unbound). Do not touch evidence.py (T011, Argus). Development runs only (no ledgered launch): build bundles into a temp dir in tests.
non_goals: No change to world predicates, the expected-answer table or S2 case expectations
No scheduler, no universal state/cognition schema (CONTRACT.md BX6, s5)
C-004 records and freezes are not rewritten
evidence_required: RED: a test that a freshly built bundle's RECEIPT rows carry parent_run_id == the build row and receipt_sha256 == sha256(receipt bytes), and the manifest launch_run_id, fails on the current code
GREEN after the change; old-ledger parse test
slice suite and rso/binding suite green

acceptance.command: python -B -m unittest discover -s rso/slice001/tests -t . && python -B -m unittest discover -s rso/binding/tests -t .
acceptance.condition: all evidence_required items; both suites green
